# PixelPress — Compress JPG to 20KB Online

> PixelPress is a free, browser-based JPG compressor for strict upload limits such as 20KB. Choose a JPG, pick a target size, and download a smaller image without login, payment, or server upload. The guide library explains size limits, photo dimensions and quality trade-offs in English and Simplified Chinese.

PixelPress is a free JPG compressor at https://compressimageto20kb.online/. Compression runs inside the browser with the Canvas API, so the selected JPG is never uploaded. The compressor accepts JPG/JPEG files only, up to 50MB each, and never asks for an account. Target-size presets are 10KB, 20KB, 30KB, 40KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 500KB, 1MB and 2MB. Batch compression and ZIP download are built in.

Every result is reported as Target reached, Closest match, or Already under target. A detailed photo may not reach a tiny target without visible damage, so the tool returns the closest clean result instead of a broken image. The site has no login, pricing, checkout, or support pages.

## Core pages
- [PixelPress JPG compressor](https://compressimageto20kb.online/): upload panel, target sizes, quality settings, guide, FAQ and downloads on one page.
- [JPG compression guides](https://compressimageto20kb.online/guides/): English library covering byte math, upload limits, passport photos, email attachments, formats and batch workflows.
- [中文 JPG 压缩指南](https://compressimageto20kb.online/zh/guides/): Simplified Chinese library with localized explanations and tools.

- [JPG vs PNG vs WebP](https://compressimageto20kb.online/guides/jpg-vs-png-vs-webp): format fit for photos, text and transparency.
- [Reduce JPG size without losing visible quality](https://compressimageto20kb.online/guides/reduce-jpg-size-without-losing-quality): crop, downscale, encode once.
